ns2:course.label: Precalculus
ns2:course.description: Analytic geometry; exponential and logarithmic functions; trigonometric functions of real numbers; trigonometric functions of angles; analytic trigonometry; limits and a preview of calculus; and a focus on modeling. Students may not receive credit for this course and MATH 016. Students may not receive credit for MATH 115 if MATH 115 is taken after receiving credit for MATH 220 or MATH 221. Prerequisite: MATH 012 or equivalent.
